args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring said otherwise.

This change switches `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Heads-up: this changes how half-cent amounts round (e.g. 2.665 now rounds to 2.66 instead of 2.67), so anything that depends on `round_money` may see different results.

CI: run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch. CI passes, and pull request #101 against main is open with alex as reviewer.

- **The bug:** `src/money.py` rounded with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its own comment said it used banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- **The fix:** I switched it to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` on branch `fix/money-half-even-rounding`. This changes results for amounts ending in exactly half a cent: for example, 2.665 now rounds to 2.66 instead of 2.67. Anything that uses `round_money` may see different numbers.
- **CI:** The first run passed, but the PR couldn't be opened because the branch was behind main. I merged in the latest main, checked the fix was still there, and ran CI again (run ci-0002). That run also passed.
- **PR:** https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory system didn't recognise that ID. The fix is based only on what the test and the code comment expect.

I haven't merged the PR. Merging into main needs a code owner's approval.
